Good for the others. Really. 🙂
Making a note: overlooked.

Great. Just great. Really, really great.

That\'s it, I\'m counting! 😠
What do they have that I don\'t?! 😤

Not one more before me! 😡
IT. IS. MY. TURN. 🤬

Enough! I\'m next! 😡

No more excuses! 😡
No more queue jumpers! 🤬

string-array.item: Hold on! I\'ve been waiting for %1$d finished tasks – and now „%2$s“ gets to go before me?!
Seriously? %1$d tasks have already overtaken me. And „%2$s“ jumps the queue again?
I watched %1$d times. Not again! „%2$s“ can wait – it\'s MY turn! 😤
„%2$s“?! Really?! I\'ve been standing here for %1$d rounds and get ignored! 🤬
Stop! Before you start „%2$s“: you\'ve passed me over %1$d times. Enough!
Do you know how it feels not to be picked %1$d times? And now „%2$s“ too? 😢
I bit my tongue %1$d times. But „%2$s“ is where I draw the line! 😡
Just so we\'re clear: %1$d tasks before me. „%2$s“ would be one more. 🤬
Hello?! I\'m still here! For %1$d tasks! What\'s with „%2$s“?
I officially protest against „%2$s“! Waiting time: %1$d tasks. Outrageous! 🪧
„%2$s“ just cut in line and I\'ve been waiting %1$d rounds. Just saying. 😤
You\'re about to make a big mistake. I waited %1$d times. Choose wisely. 🤨

string-array.item: Make way! It\'s my turn now 😤
Step aside, coming through! 💪

Cutting in line? I can do that too! 😏
Bye bottom! Hello top! 👋

Thanks! I\'ll do my very best! 😊
I\'ll never forget this! 💖
